text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home after accompanying Tokai 
Teio on a shopping trip—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, do you remember that 
assignment the Pres gave us?
choice_data_list: "What does a Trainer mean to you"?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I just came up with a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"When I saw Scarlet the other day, she 
told me all about it—"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I see. "What a Trainer means to you," 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally stuck~. What would you answer 
if it were you, Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, what a first-world problem~ And 
here I am, actively searching for a 
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, all right. If I were to answer, 
let's see—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The best partner who supports me in making 
my dreams come true, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A trainer supports their Umamusume with 
everything they have, and the Umamusume 
responds to that trainer's expectations 
and dedication.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us will aim for the top 
together. ...That's about it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh, I see~. Now I get it~!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... that look on your face. You're 
thinking about something weird, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, not at all! It was really 
helpful, thanks a bunch♪"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey Trainer, what did you think of 
Scarlet's answer?
choice_data_list: I thought that was a textbook answer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right? As expected of an honor student! 
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"If I put a little of my own spin on it, 
don't you think even the Prez would 
agree!?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm really on fire today~♪
choice_data_list: That would be against the rules.
Isn't that against the rules?
I want you to look straight at me.
I want you to properly look at me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm really on fire today~♪
choice_data_list: That would be against the rules.
Isn't that against the rules?
I want you to look straight at me.
I want you to properly look at me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mmh. I get it~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't you think using our heads 
like this is a great way to solve 
problems?
choice_data_list:
Would the President really be satisfied 
with a fake answer?

Will the President really be satisfied 
with a fake answer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, they probably won't, but as long as 
we don't get caught, nobody will know...
choice_data_list: That's not the issue here.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Then what is it, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To a disgruntled Tokai Teio, I said that 
if she wanted to surpass Symboli Rudolf, 
she should learn from her outside of races 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Urgh...
choice_data_list:
The Chairwoman isn't the kind of umamusume 
who'd cheat, right?
The Chairwoman wouldn't cheat, would she?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. The President is always so 
straightforward and radiant.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“......I'm sorry. I'll make sure to think 
it through for myself.”
choice_data_list:
Let's find an answer that'll surprise the 
Chairwoman!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for, um... giving me a proper 
scolding back there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By admitting her mistake and apologizing 
honestly, Tokai Teio seems to have grown a 
little bit more.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: That's a story about her ideals.
That's a story about her ideals, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's true, but... Isn't it a good 
answer?
choice_data_list: But it's not about me...
Still, this isn't about me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I told her that I was hurt and 
shocked that she had given up on facing 
herself—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Trainer! I didn't mean it like 
that—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Don't look so sad~! I was wrong, 
I'm sorryyyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, it seemed like Tokai Teio 
was the one about to cry.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it some proper thought one more 
time. About what you, my Trainer, mean to 
me.
choice_data_list:
Let's find an answer that'll surprise the 
Chairwoman!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Hey, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Thanks for stopping me back there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By admitting her mistake and apologizing 
honestly, Tokai Teio seems to have grown a 
little bit more.
